text:
morgan: quick follow-up on intake design: thinking of adding a 'prefilter attestation' that returns a confidence score + a short probe summary. goal: avoid wasted bench runs and make async verdicts auditable.

lee: +1. what do you mean by attestation? lightweight checks only?

morgan: lightweight yes: tokenization-hash, shape check, 30-item smoke probes, tiny embedding sanity. attestation payload = {prefilter_score, probe_id, token_hash}. keep it under 20s.

carmen: Important: bench infra should sign results (bench_signature) so intake/runtime can verify bench outputs weren't tampered with. also include a short in-line delta summary (1-2 bullets) in webhook.

bench-bot: queued bench job: candidate=cand-1776543210, est_gpu_hours=3.1, eta~6h, webhook=/hooks/bench/result.

lee: lifecycle idea: submitted -> attested -> queued_verif -> verifying -> limited_lift -> staged_canary -> promoted | quarantined | rejected. limited_lift = internal-only low volume to catch org-specific regressions.

morgan: rollout recipe: attested -> shadow 12-24h -> limited_lift 0.05% internal 6-12h -> external canary 0.1%->1% ramp. bench can veto anytime.

carmen: ops knobs: org_gpu_credits/day, per_candidate_gpu_cap, bench_queue_ttl (48h), auto-stale rules. intake must surface current org credits and warn if near limit.

ops-bot: note: bench_queue_depth=4, median_wait=1.3h, org_default_credits=10 GPUh/day.

lee: failure modes: if bench returns WARN -> quarantined_pending_owner + diff link; FAIL -> quarantine + auto-rollback if any traffic routed. attestation mismatches (token_hash diff) -> immediate reject.

morgan: also allow rebench with new probe_id or promote-with-override (requires two approvers + audit entry). will add UI actions: rebench, override-promote, cancel.

carmen: will draft webhook schema (keys only) and brief runbook for bench-stuck and quota exhaustion. examples in RFC.

morgan: thanks team, i'll sketch RFC tonight. reviewers: lee for state machine, carmen for bench schema, ops for quota/runbook. :coffee:
